title: Non-anchor absolute-position period-3 prediction v40
rationale: This lane predeclares one absolute-position period-3 residue target set before any new evidence is scored. It is not another public-anchor mining pass because discovery does not use known-plaintext anchors, additive fragment values, candidate key material, routed-key results, held-out anchor controls, source-expanded candidate screens, or prior public-fragment structure scores.
prediction_target: Future independently documented non-anchor K4 position observations should be enriched in one or more predeclared one-based absolute-position residue classes for period 3 at a rate exceeding seeded null and residue multiple-comparison controls.
discovery_inputs: predeclared absolute K4 position numbers only
registered period-3 residue family before source-backed observation scoring
one-based residue classes emitted without candidate words, keys, or routes
evaluation_inputs: future independently source-documented non-anchor K4 position observations
source-reviewed observation rows that are not public known-plaintext anchor fragments
controls: seeded same-size non-anchor position shuffle baseline
multiple-comparison correction across the three period-3 residue targets
promotion blocked unless future independent observations beat all predeclared controls without post-hoc retuning
